description: This file defines a Java class `ReportCommandFromApiJsonDeserializer` responsible for deserializing and validating JSON input related to report commands within the Apache Fineract project. It uses a helper class to parse JSON and ensures only supported parameters are present.

classes.name: ReportCommandFromApiJsonDeserializer
